newsitem.title: FRANCE: RHONE POULENC ISSUES SHARES FOR DIVIDENDS.
newsitem.headline: RHONE POULENC ISSUES SHARES FOR DIVIDENDS.

text.p: French chemicals company Rhone Poulenc said on Thursday that its capital was increased by 806,862,953 francs after shareholders representing 69.9 percent of the capital voted to receive their dividends in shares, resulting in the creation of 4,774,337 new shares.

Rhone Poulenc had proposed to pay its dividend in cash or shares at a nominal price of 169 francs per share, a five percent discount from the average share price over the 20 days preceding the annual general meeting on April 23.
The net dividend per share was 3.50 francs.
Rhone Poulenc now has 334,209,122 shares outstanding.
On Wednesday, Rhone Poulenc shares closed at 259.70 francs.
